title: Berlin bear: fifteen-frame dancing woodcut
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 15-frame transparent animation sprite atlas for an existing small website woodcut.
PRIMARY REFERENCE: ONLY the rightmost black Berlin heraldic bear in the supplied image. Treat it as the exact original character, not loose style inspiration. Ignore/remove the bus and Statue of Liberty completely.
Request: make this exact black heraldic bear DANCE. Fifteen individually drawn full-body poses forming one lively but dignified continuous dance loop. Preserve the original left-facing head with very long blocky snout, tiny black eye, short rounded ears, open mouth and curling tongue, large thick torso, clawed paws, heavy wide clawed feet, short legs and heraldic silhouette. Keep face identical across frames, no smiling expression, no anthropomorphic/cartoon redesign. Black ink silhouette with extremely subtle charcoal rough print grain. NO prominent white scratch marks, no pale chest stripes, no white cheek/eye highlights. Texture should remain as quiet and dark as the source.
Dance: clearly alternating stepping feet and kicking one knee, opposite front paws rise and lower, restrained side-to-side hip sway and bounce. This must be true whole-body dancing visible at40px height, not repeated small paw waves. Feet intentionally alternate off the ground. Original upright left-facing bear at frame1. Frames2–4: weight shifts onto rear foot, front knee lifts and clawed foot kicks forward while lower front paw rises. Frames5–7: front foot lands, hips pass through centre with a downward bounce, upper paw dips. Frames8–11: weight shifts onto front foot, other knee/foot lifts while upper front paw rises and lower paw dips; hips sway oppositely. Frames12–14 settle through a bounce and back to original stance; frame15 near frame1 for a seamless loop. Modest broad motion, exact same character and same body size.
Layout: EXACTLY15 bears, 5 columns by3 rows, row-major reading order. Square canvas1536×1536 if available, divided into fifteen equal-width equal-height invisible cells. Consistent common ground baseline and character anchor inside every cell. Identical scale in all cells; do not resize each pose to fit. Generous transparent margins so even the kicks and waving paws stay fully inside their cell. All15 complete full bodies, no crops. No other objects, no labels, no text, no frame lines.
True transparent alpha background, transparent gutters. Preserve the original's mature black blockprint appearance, no paper rectangle, no glow, no outline, no shadows, no3D.
notes: Source PNG copied unchanged. Dancing silhouette uses stepping feet, forward knee kicks, alternating front paws and hip sway. Fifteen complete full bodies. Generated grid spacing/scale approximates equal cells; metadata contains alpha>=128 bounds for packing and registration. Original static artwork should remain at rest.
